messages.text:
1. Is this the answer from Mike?
2. On my Hammer BC04 shipment, why can't it be delivered? All of the miners
you've sent before came with no problem, yet the BC04 has a message from
USPS saying it can't be delivered. I don't understand. I have a question to
Customer Service for this in yesterday and no one has messaged me back
saying anything about the shipment. It's order:
Shop····
Handed to the team · Compensation amount is above what I can give and has been promised to him since

Hi Tom,

No, that was not Mike's answer. The $75 store credit on your account was ours to apply and I applied it. The compensation figure for the hashrate you lost is still Mike's and Abel's to set, and it is in front of them with the full history. They are back Monday at 10am ET and that answer comes to you right here.

On the BC04, I found the reason. That parcel, on order Shop····, tracking ····, went out signature required. Your earlier miners did not, which is why they simply landed on your doorstep. The carrier tried once, nobody could sign, and the box is now sitting at your local post office waiting for you. The last scan on it was October 24.

Two ways to clear it. Either schedule a redelivery with USPS using that tracking number and be there to sign, or collect it from the post office holding it. Please do it this week, because an unclaimed parcel gets sent back to our warehouse after about fifteen days, and then it has to be shipped out all over again.

If the post office says they do not have it, or it has already started back to us, tell me and I will have a new one sent to you rather than wait for the first to travel back.

Sarah

All my prior shipments from your company didn't require a signature. Why is
the BC04 different?

Hi Tom,

You are right, and I checked every one of them. Your Bitaxe Gamma in August, the NerdQaxe++ order in September and the two replacement units on October 21 all went out with no signature needed. The B.04 is the only parcel on your account that carried one.

I do not have a reason recorded for it, and I am not going to make one up for you. The signature flag is set on the individual box when it is packed, not by the product, so nothing about a BC04 calls for it. It looks like it was set by mistake when that box was made up after the Thor X1 swap. It should have gone out like all the others.

That still leaves the box sitting with your post office. The fastest route is to schedule a redelivery on tracking ···· and sign for it, or pick it up at the office holding it. Please do that this week, since an unclaimed parcel heads back to our warehouse after about fifteen days.

If you would rather not chase it, say the word and I will let it come back and send you a fresh BC04 with no signature on the label, at no cost to you.

Sarah

I tried to schedule a redelivery with USPS using the number you gave me and
received the following message:

Hi Tom,

That is on me. (number hidden) is our warehouse's own tracking number, not a USPS one, which is why their form rejects it. USPS only accepts their own barcode.

Two ways to get the USPS number. Open (tracking link hidden) and the carrier's own tracking number for that parcel is shown on that page, and that is the one USPS will take. Or, if the driver left a slip at your door, the barcode printed on the back of that PS Form 3849 is exactly what their redelivery form is asking for.

If neither gets you anywhere, do not spend any more of your Saturday on it. Tell me and I will stop chasing that box, let it come back to us, and send you a fresh BC04 with no signature on the label, at no cost to you. Say the word and I will set it going.

Sarah
